description: Set a user's ban state in this app: "none" (lift), "banned" (the app shows the ban message and blocks play; Neblla refuses everything but their messages to you), "terminated" (blocks them for good: their device is sealed so the app no longer opens there, and they are disconnected), "community_muted" (can play, and can still REPORT entries, but cannot publish, rate or review). Takes effect live. WARNING: "terminated" seals the user's device, and lifting it with "none" does not unseal a device that is already sealed (the user has to clear the site's data) — never pass it unless the developer asked for that specific value. The other two are fully reversible with "none". This tool keeps no reason, no note and no history: if the developer needs a record of why someone was sanctioned, write it yourself with neblla_send_communication or in a community case note. Confirm with the developer before banned/terminated.
name: neblla_set_ban_status
